preview.description: If true, display changes in a human reviewable format instead of modifying files in-place.

fixed_strings.description: If true, treat the search pattern and replacement string as literal text, disabling regex interpretation.

max_replacements.description: Maximum number of replacements to perform per file. 0 indicates no limit.

flags.description: List of regex flag characters to apply. Valid characters are 'c', 'e', 'i', 'm', 's', 'w'. These are joined into a single string passed to the -f flag.
